evidence.quote: The alloys used in this study were prepared by vacuum induction melting and precision casting from high-purity nickel, aluminium and cerium metals as well as a Ni—B master alloy.
All the ingots were homogenized for 3 h at 1150°C under an argon atmosphere

parameters.deformation: 20% reduction in the first rolling, subsequent 30% after each intermediate anneal

evidence.quote: fabricated into sheets 2 and 0.8 mm in thickness, respectively, by repeated rolling at room temperature with intermediate anneals at 1000°C for 0.5 h. A reduction in thickness of 20% was applied in the first rolling and subsequently 30% after each intermediate anneal.

The sheet specimens of the alloys were isothermally treated at 550 °C for 120 h, 750 °C for 40 h, 1000 °C for 1 h, and 1200°C for 0.5 h in vacuum, respectively, followed by air cooling to room temperature.
